title: Hinomori Shizuku — Determined Brilliance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you seeing anything, Saito...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Not a single new offer, it seems...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'm sorry that this investigation has taken as much time as it already has. I wish I could do more for all of you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
It could just be that we're not quite who everyone is looking for right now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and we know that you're doing your best for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If anything, one could argue that we could be doing more as a group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In any case, let's try to see things in a positive light.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
For example...
We now have more time for our streams.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! Especially since there were times when we had to take breaks from our streams, or all four of us weren't present!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: True... Oh, since our schedule is open right now, why don't we try streaming every day for a whole week?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: E-Every day for a whole week?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
What a wonderful reward for...
No, I mean... Are you sure? I mean, that sounds like a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's gonna take a lot of preparation, and it wouldn't really be possible under normal circumstances...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we have plenty of time on our hands right now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like for us to do streams each day with the theme of “Let's Do Our Best Together This Week♪” in mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That sounds nice...
We can definitely set aside some time to get ready for it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Plus, we're not appearing as much on TV right now, so it'll be good for us to let everyone know that we're still around by doing ambitious streams like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also don't mind if it's gonna be a lot of work. I wanna try doing streams for a whole week!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, if it's for our fans, then I'm willing to take on tough challenges like this one!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too! Chances like this don't come around often, so let's make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, during the week, we'll do morning streams of us doing stretches that can help wake you up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know. Since we're probably gonna be working late into the night preparing for the next day, why don't we all stay here at the MORE MORE HOUSE?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That way, we can film the person who gets up last each morning. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, like a sleepover? That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, I'm probably gonna be the last person to get up! My hair's always a gigantic mess, so I'd sort of rather not be seen...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me of our training camp...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, don't remember! That was so embarrassing for me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Given that we're going to have solid ideas for our streams on Saturday and Sunday, it'd be nice to do evening streams during the week too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
How does doing an evening or late-night stream each day sound?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Two in one day!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
B-But! Are you sure?!
That means we'd get to see you all twice each day during the week!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saito already sees us basically every day, and look how happy she is. That sounds worth doing to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That just leaves exactly what we're going to do...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, I know. What if we tried making dinner together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, more cooking streams?!
The ones we've done in the past have all done really well!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. I was thinking that we could try making some simple but nutritious dishes so that everyone else can follow along with.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I like that. We could even take it a step further by asking everyone to post pictures of their dishes on social media.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, if we're gonna do that, then we could post the recipes in advance and invite everyone to cook along with us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, we'll take the pictures they post on social media and bring them up during the stream!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is it! Our first day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everything is ready to go, so let's make this week a fun one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku! You came up with this idea, so you have the honors!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make “MORE MORE WEEK! Spend a week with MORE MORE JUMP!” a fun experience for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: MORE MORE...!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: GUSTO!
One week later

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Nice work with MORE MORE WEEK, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mmm...! This juice tastes so good!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: We have plenty, so feel free to have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Just doing streams for a week sounded challenging enough, but you even ended up making short videos of your dance practices... I honestly still can't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: We've also seen a lot more subscribers to the channel over this week, so I would call this a definite success.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad we did this. Our fans seemed to really enjoy hanging out with us each day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I also had a lot of fun this past week.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! Can I get a refill on my juice, Saito?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We still haven't been able to figure out why we've stopped receiving offers...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But as long as we have all these people supporting us, then we have to keep doing what we can for them.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And I'm not worried. I'm sure we'll figure out a way to get through this.)
